name: Required column missing
explanation: Dataset structure differs from the expected schema

name: Status column missing
explanation: Dataset structure differs from the expected schema

name: Unexpected extra column
explanation: Dataset structure differs from the expected schema

name: Missing key or detector telemetry
explanation: The observation cannot be placed in time or is missing a value the analysis needs

name: Missing connection status
explanation: Status unavailable; status-based checks skip this minute

name: Missing study label
explanation: Study-label integrity: the row cannot be evaluated (synthetic-study field)

name: Invalid connection status
explanation: Status value outside UP/UNSTABLE, e.g. a vendor or version format difference

name: Invalid study label
explanation: Study-label integrity: label value outside the allowed set

name: Negative telemetry value
explanation: Delay, jitter, throughput and rates cannot be negative

name: Percentage above 100
explanation: A share of packets, frames or segments cannot exceed 100%

name: Throughput above link capacity
explanation: Delivered traffic cannot exceed the configured link capacity

name: Duplicate episode/minute
explanation: The same observation key appears more than once

name: Duplicate timestamp
explanation: The same timestamp appears more than once within an episode

name: Timestamp out of sequence
explanation: A timestamp is earlier than the previous record's in the same episode

name: Timestamp gap
explanation: Observations are missing between this record and the previous one

name: Status inconsistent with loss
explanation: connection_state disagrees with the rule UNSTABLE <=> probe loss >= 5%

name: Frozen probe metrics
explanation: Latency and jitter repeat exactly, as from a stuck poller

name: Saturated error counter
explanation: Every frame reported as failing while traffic is still delivered

name: Statistically unusual value
explanation: Far from the bulk of the data; kept, NOT evidence of bad data
